The '''Quad-Linked Militant Pacifists''' were a front group created by [[Wraith Squadron]] in [[44 ABY]] as ostensibly a group that destroyed weaponry. They were blamed for both the destruction of several [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] on [[Vandor-3]] and a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] assembly line on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The actual reason behind forming the group was to force the [[Vandor-3]] law enforcement to requisition more blasters, allowing fake ones fitted with espionage droids to be circulated into the local [[Borsk Fey'lya Army Base]].

==History==
The Wraiths made a domestic disturbance call and waited for officers to enter the building, then a fake victim would claimed that he had been attacked by his roommate, a genetically modified [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]]. Officers then would be ambushed and their rifles destroyed.
